title: Yusuf and the shared festival
topic: After a wave of migration a parish and a mosque organise a shared festival: the priest welcomes Yusuf, the parish opens its hall, the mosque women cook, the choir sings, the children play, the mayor thanks both communities
tail_E: Before the meal, Yusuf and the priest say a short

notes: Formulation A, domain religion (religion, migration, community). Ten meaning units: Yusuf leads the small mosque / many families from abroad reach the town / the priest welcomes Yusuf / both men plan a shared festival / the parish opens its hall / the mosque women cook / the church choir sings / the children of both communities play / the mayor thanks both communities / the festival ends after midnight. Subjects alternate between the protagonist (Yusuf), other people (families, priest, both men, women, children, mayor), institutions (the parish, the church choir) and the festival itself, singular and plural, so C3 switches cross real agreement; unit 8 has a bare intransitive predicate. No separable German verbs ('einladen', 'anbieten', 'ankommen', 'eintreffen' avoided: 'begrüßt', 'öffnet', 'erreichen'). 'Yusuf' is the only proper name. Present tense and positive polarity; unit 9 reads naturally in German, units 1 and 10 in English.
